                                      ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. That Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-H in the area bounded by:

       a line 120.0 feet north of and parallel to West Fulleilon Avenue; North Oakley
       Avenue; West Fullerton Avenue; and the alley next west of and parallel to North
       Oakley Avenue

to those of a CI-2 Neighborhood Commercial District.


SECTION 2.      This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.




Common Address of Property:         2400-2410 North Oakley Avenue / 2300-2308 West
                                    Fullerton Avenue
                      TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT APPLICATION
                           PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                 2400-2410 NORTH OAKLEY AVENUE / 2300-2308 WEST
                               FULLERTON AVENUE

Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District to CI-2 Neighborhood Commercial District

The Applicant seeks to rezone the Subject Property from Ml-2 to Cl-2 in order to allow for the
business activity of general retail sales to be permitted. The existing one-story 6,821 square foot
commercial structure will remain. The existing off-street parking lot will remain, providing nine
off-street parking spaces. No changes will be made to the bulk, height or exterior structure of the
building. No residential dwelling units are being proposed.
